name: AI Sales Team for Claude Code
summary: Claude Code skill package with 14 sales skills and 5 parallel agents for prospect research, BANT/MEDDIC scoring and outreach.
description: Skills and agents installed into Claude Code: slash commands such as /sales prospect, /sales quick and /sales outreach orchestrate company research, lead qualification, decision-maker mapping, cold email sequences, meeting prep, proposals and PDF pipeline reports. Skills detect and build on each other's output files; optional Python scripts add PDF reports.
contains: orchestrator skill routes to 13 sub-skills; 5 parallel agents run /sales prospect
14 slash commands cover research, qualification, outreach, proposals and reports
weighted 0-100 prospect score across 5 dimensions; BANT and MEDDIC frameworks
one-command or manual install into ~/.claude; optional Python packages for PDF reports
